issue: A task that was marked BLOCKED cannot be moved back to IN_PROGRESS once the blocker is resolved; the service raises 'cannot move task from blocked to in_progress'. Resuming a blocked task should be allowed.

ground_truth.root_cause: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[Status.BLOCKED] does not contain Status.IN_PROGRESS, so ensure_transition rejects BLOCKED -> IN_PROGRESS.
ground_truth.fix: Add Status.IN_PROGRESS to the allowed transitions of Status.BLOCKED.
